name: Breaded Dijon Chicken & Green Bean Salad with Lemon-Parsley Gremolata

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Place half in a small bowl and half in a large bowl. (Set large bowl aside for later use.)
Add mayo and Dijon to the small bowl with the garlic. Stir to combine the Dijon mayo.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
3 tbsp Dijon mustard

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken dry with paper towels, place on a large baking sheet pan, then season with salt and pepper on both sides. Spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless
salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Spread the Dijon mayo over the top side of the chicken, then sprinkle with bread crumbs, pressing gently to adhere. Drizzle with oil.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until chicken is golden and cooked through, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ small bunches Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
3 lb green beans

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot about two-thirds with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
While the water is heating, zest lemons into the bowl with the reserved garlic. Cut lemons into wedges and set aside for serving.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with additional oil and salt; stir to combine gremolata and set aside.
Once the water in the pot is boiling, add green beans and additional salt; cook until tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool.
Add cooled green beans to the bowl with the gremolata. Toss to coat.
To serve, divide chicken and green beans between plates; squeeze lemon over top. Enjoy!
